# TDrive v3.0.0

TDrive v3.0.0 is the first release of the TDrive fork maintained by Nguyễn Dương Gia Thuận (ndgthuan/tdrive). It rebuilds the interface in a calmer true-black style, adds an AI assistant that can work on your drive, a built-in media downloader for links, and a set of file-manager and settings improvements. It is built on the upstream TDrive v2.2.0 codebase by Jeetraj.

## Highlights

- Calm true-black redesign of every screen, with a single slate accent and the Be Vietnam Pro interface font.
- AI assistant side panel with Agent and Ask modes. Agent mode can list, search, create, rename, move, trash and restore items, and organize photos and videos. Destructive actions always ask first and can be undone.
- Download from link: fetch media with yt-dlp into any drive or folder.
- Sources view with grid and list modes, thumbnails, and downloads for channel posts.
- Upload tray with Google Drive style progress.
- Settings dialog reorganized into General, Appearance, Language, AI Models and Account.
- Interface available in 19 languages.
- On Windows the mounted drive appears as a "Telegram Drive" folder in Explorer.

## Redesign

- Dark mode defaults to a true-black canvas (`#000000`) with flat surfaces and one slate accent. Other palettes remain selectable in Appearance.
- Interface font is Be Vietnam Pro, bundled for offline use. Icons are Phosphor.
- File list: press and hold a row to enter multi-select; row actions are centered in their own column and always visible; the row icon slot is unified across files, folders and sources.
- Folders use a bare filled folder glyph instead of a bordered tile.
- Composer and input focus use a muted accent border and a soft ring.
- The main pane adapts to narrow windows: action layouts change at smaller widths and the AI panel overlays the content below about 1140 px.
- Breadcrumbs and titles show the active drive's name (for example a shared drive) instead of always "My Drive".

## Settings

- **General**: account-independent preferences, the updater (check, download and install new releases from ndgthuan/tdrive), and the About and attribution notice.
- **Appearance**: palette and theme choices.
- **Language**: every supported language listed by its native name.
- **AI Models**: add providers and models. Keys are stored in the operating system's credential store, not in the app's data files. On Windows this is Credential Manager; on other platforms the system keyring is used.
- **Account**: sign-out and account details. The duplicate sign-out button was removed.

About (in General) credits the original author and links to the fork and the upstream project, and includes the license notice.

## AI assistant

- Opens as a side panel. Two modes:
  - **Agent**: the model may call drive tools.
  - **Ask**: chat only, no drive changes.
- Model picker per chat, with brand logos for Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (which takes a base URL).
- The scope chip follows the drive you have open and can switch between drives.
- Agent tools: `list_files`, `search_files`, `create_folder`, `rename_item`, `move_items`, `delete_items` (moves to Trash only), `list_trash`, `restore_items`, `empty_trash` (always asks; permanent), `view_media` (lets a vision model look at photo thumbnails and video posters), and `organize_photos`.
- Approval cards are shown before any change that needs confirmation. The action timeline records each step, and an Undo control reverses supported actions.
- Organize photos and videos: the assistant builds a preview plan of folders and file moves first; nothing moves until you apply it, and the apply can be undone.

## Sources

- Grid and list toggle for channel sources; the choice is remembered on that device.
- Photo and video posts show a small Telegram preview thumbnail (view-only, size and JPEG checked before display).
- Source posts can be downloaded from the context menu, the row and grid buttons, or the viewer, through the same download queue as files. The file is written to a temporary `.part` file and renamed when complete.

## Download from link (yt-dlp)

- Paste a link in the "Download from link" dialog and pick a quality preset: best, 1080p, 720p, 480p, audio MP3, or audio M4A.
- Choose the destination across all drives and folders with the picker.
- yt-dlp and FFmpeg are discovered on the system. On Windows, TDrive can install both: the downloads come from the yt-dlp GitHub release pages, and each asset is checked against the SHA-256 list published with it before it is used. The installer refuses an asset whose digest does not match.
- Merging separate video and audio streams and audio extraction need FFmpeg; those options are offered only when FFmpeg is found.
- The finished file is added to the destination folder you chose.

## Upload tray

- A Google Drive style card shows each upload's progress, can collapse and expand, and can be dismissed when finished.

## Shared drives and Windows mount

- Shared drive names appear in breadcrumbs and titles.
- The Windows mount is labeled "Telegram Drive".

## Storage format

- Control messages in the Telegram channel now use a readable caption format (`TDrive | type=... | time=...`). Captions in the older `TDX1` form are still read.
- Permanent delete removes every Telegram message that belongs to the object, not only the first one.

## Fixes

- Permanent delete purges all messages of an item (see Storage format).
- Row action buttons are shown in file and channel lists without hovering.
- Narrow-window layout fits the sources list and the file list actions.
- Tests can no longer read or write your real TDrive data directory.

## Platform notes

- **macOS (Apple silicon, arm64)**: the app bundle is not notarized. macOS may ask you to confirm opening it the first time (right-click, Open).
- **Windows (amd64)**: installer and portable zip, plus the CLI archive.
- **Linux (amd64)**: AppImage, self-contained (glibc 2.35 or newer).
- **Android (arm64)**: APK signed with this fork's release key. Android will not install it as an update over APKs signed with the upstream key, so install it fresh (uninstall the upstream app first, which removes its local data).
- **iOS**: the IPA (`TDrive-v3.0.0-ios-unsigned.ipa`) is signed only ad hoc, with no Apple developer certificate or provisioning profile, so it cannot be installed through the App Store or TestFlight. TrollStore installs it as-is; Sideloadly and AltStore re-sign it with your own Apple ID.
- Mobile builds are inherited from upstream and have had only light testing in this fork.
- The AI assistant and the download-from-link feature are new in this release and have had only light testing.

## Known limitations

- Automatic installation of yt-dlp and FFmpeg is available on Windows only. On macOS and Linux, install both yourself and make sure they are on your PATH.
- Updates come from ndgthuan/tdrive releases only. Builds from the upstream project will not see this fork's releases, and this fork does not see upstream releases.
- The AI assistant depends on the provider you configure; quality, latency and tool-calling behavior vary by model.
- Downloading media is subject to the terms of the source site and your local law. Use it only for content you are allowed to keep.

## Upgrade notes

- Desktop data and configuration directories are unchanged, so existing data is found automatically.
- Do not downgrade to v2.x after using v3.0.0 on the same account. Older builds parse only the `TDX1` caption form, so they cannot read the readable captions v3.0.0 writes.
- The AI assistant is new in this release. Add provider keys in Settings > AI Models.
- Android: see Platform notes; the APK cannot update over an upstream-signed install.

- Android signer certificate SHA-256: `A8:F4:4A:72:E0:56:E1:79:DE:19:4C:F3:E3:10:84:9D:5C:B6:BA:5A:58:EC:5F:A6:AD:BA:DD:29:FB:DC:22:92`
